# RAGFlow v0.27.2 Coverage Matrix

- Fixed commit: `a024bea0cd93f39e6652a42bf84dd20c55bc560b`
- RAGFlow files: `5977`
- Baseline migration: carried 4132 rows from the RAGFlow v0.26.4 ledger; 2222 rows changed upstream and the 515 audited ones are marked `[v0.27.2 content changed: re-audit]`; 1845 paths are new (1353 matched the upstream reference rules — internal Go / tests / docs / repository automation; 492 start as `unmapped`); 309 paths were removed upstream.
- Detailed delta: `docs/ragflow-v0.27.2-delta.md` lists the re-audit queue, the added paths and the removed paths.
- Inventory validation: `cargo run --locked --bin ragflow-coverage -- --check
  /path/to/ragflow-v0.27.2` validates the fixed commit plus every Git path/blob/byte/text-line
  and the summary; use `--write` after an intentional status edit to refresh metadata and totals.
- Policy: `aligned` means audited behavior, not a literal Python-to-Rust transliteration. `replaced` records an intentional Rust/PostgreSQL/zvec substitute. `Source lines` are counted from the pinned Git blobs; binary blobs are shown as `-`.

- Classification guard: unknown paths become `unmapped`; only explicit mappings or test/fixture rules may produce `reference`.
- `internal/` (Go production code): classified `reference` — RAGFlow's Go sub-project is outside the Python parity scope; its functionality (admin API, binding, cache, cli, dao) is covered by RayRAG's Rust modules (`src/server.rs`, `src/store/`, `src/api/`).
- `N/A-by-design`: non-Rust targets and non-code artifacts (Node/Go entrypoints, documentation, packaging/lockfile metadata, empty package markers) that are intentionally outside the Rust port scope; the audit note records where the equivalent semantics live, if any.

| `web/src/pages/agents/agent-log-page.tsx` | 420 | 13034 | `7d48ec7a1bf300b8` | aligned | `src/web.rs; src/api/agent_log.rs` | v0.3.7a: `/agent-log-page/:id` ported (`src/web.rs::agent_log_page` + `agent_log_script`, `src/api/agent_log.rs`). PageHeader breadcrumb Agent › canvas title › `flow.log`; toolbar `flow.export` + `flow.id/flow.logTitle` keyword box + `flow.latestDate` range picker + `common.search`/`common.reset`; the eight upstream columns (ID / User ID / Title / State dot / Number / Latest date ↓↑ / Create date ↓↑ / Version) over the `{code,message,data,total}` envelope; RAGFlow pagination (10/20/50/100 per page, `pagination.page`/`pagination.total` wording); loading and `common.noData` rows; row click opens the detail modal only when `round` is truthy (`showLogDetail`). Note: upstream `api.ts::fetchAgentLogs` still calls `/v1/canvas/{id}/sessions`, a route this release no longer serves after the `sdk` blueprints moved into `restful_apis`, so the shipped React page 404s; RayRAG serves the `webAPI` spelling plus `/api/v1/agents/{id}/sessions` from the same handler. `version_title` is stamped at session creation and the DSL snapshot is refreshed per run (`record_agent_run`), so the Version/state columns stay truthful. Two deliberate deviations, both recorded: an unknown `orderby` falls back to the date column the filters use instead of raising `getter_by`'s 500, and `common.reset` clears the filters/range/sort while keeping the page size the user selected (upstream resets the request to `page_size: 10` but leaves the size changer showing the old value, so its pager and its page disagree until the next change). Rows and the date filters use the **server-local** wall clock (`format_local_datetime`), matching `DataBaseModel.create_date = DateTimeField(default=datetime.now)`; `docker-compose.yml` pins the container clock with `TZ=${RAYRAG_TIMEZONE:-Asia/Shanghai}` (RAGFlow's `TIMEZONE` knob) so a browser in the same zone filters the day it actually picked. Still open from the same table: the `/admin` subtree (`/admin` is upstream's admin *login*, plus `/admin/services`, `/admin/users`, `/admin/users/:id`, `/admin/sandbox-settings` and the enterprise-only whitelist/roles/monitoring — all registered by RayRAG, per-file residuals tracked on their own rows), the `/chunk` subtree (`/chunk`, `/chunk/parsed/chunks`, `/chunk/chunk/:id`, `/chunk/result/:id`), v0.3.8o closed `/agent/share` (the embeddable chat with the `APIToken.beta` credential, `/api/v1/system/tokens` and the `agentbots` inputs/completions endpoints; the beta-only `logs/<message_id>` trace and the floating-widget embed remain open). v0.3.8p closed `/dataflow-result` (the ingestion-log viewer with the timeline, the step result panel, the chunk result bar, the rerun flow and the dataset-row `View result` entry, backed by the new ingestion endpoints). Still open from the same table: `/agent/:id/explore`, `/agent/share` and `/dataflow-result` are registered, while the beta-only `agentbots/logs/<message_id>` trace, the floating-widget embed and the enterprise-only `/admin` whitelist/roles/monitoring entries remain [v0.27.2 content changed: re-audit] |
